findings: SceneFlowEstimator uses RAFT forward/backward flow, in-bound endpoints and cycle residual norm < threshold (default2, renderer5 pixels). This is geometric consistency, not exact content equality or a corpus duplicate search. Returned coordinates flatten matches across batches.
Scene-flow computation asserts only image maximum <=1, not minimum/finiteness. Train-RAFT branch ignores return_np_array; static API difference.

render_pcd permits num_sides==1 or2, but accumulation always accesses global_out_list[1]. One-view path constructs only zero side IDs and calls render_pcd, so nonempty one-side rendering reaches inconsistent indexing if prior operations succeed. Not runtime-tested.

compute_scene_flow_one_side uses self.src_mask1/self.src_mask2 and self.intrinsic1/self.intrinsic2 despite reverse-direction second call swapping RGB/depth/features arguments; different masks/intrinsics need separate validation.
num_pts_2==0 leads all_side_ids[-0:]=1 assigning every point to side1. No explicit empty-side validation. Static edge case.

get_cropping_ids returns bad for insufficient coverage; both render branches compute bad but do not use it. Inclusive last coordinate is subsequently used as exclusive crop bound, dropping final row/column even for fully valid extent.
Renderer actually calls normalize_0_1 for depth decoding; original utility yields all NaN on constant input in isolated NumPy control. Real tensor/model execution not performed.

Utility float2uint8 does not clip: original body maps [1.1,-0.1] to [24,231]. crop_boundary with ratio0 preserves shape, ratio0.5 produces empty spatial dimensions; valid argument policy not enforced locally.

normalize_for_grid_sample divides by w-1,h-1 with no singleton-dimension guard. masked_median_blur uses global extrema substitutions for invalid entries; not qualified against a masked-neighborhood reference.
No flow smoothness or criterion min-max normalization call appears in these three additional files; repository-wide caller exclusion remains unproven.

executed_controls.method: Unchanged original NumPy-compatible utility AST bodies, NumPy1.26.4. No Torch/model imports.

limits: No GPU, RAFT, DPT, model weights, full rendering or upstream suite execution.
